question: Q8 gate: which character marks compound members in GRA <k2>?

convention.emDashInK2: absent; U+2014 occurs only in running text/phrase brackets
convention.rule: GRA segments a compound headword with '-'; '/' is a spelling variant separator, not a member boundary. No depth metric may read U+2014 as a GRA member marker.
convention.statedBefore: no model was called before this audit was written

finding: The cited 5,497 hyphens vs 1,045 em dashes cannot be a GRA <k2> comparison: GRA <k2> has zero em dashes. The em dashes are text punctuation (phrase brackets and ellipses), so only the hyphen column is a segmentation convention. The pilot therefore samples hyphenated headwords and asks whether the model reads the same two-member split GRA marks.

pilotFrame.universe: GRA <k2> containing at least one hyphen
